question.criteria: Any scripted American television or streaming series generally classified as a situation comedy counts.

answers.evidence: Friends follows six friends living in New York City.
Seinfeld follows a fictionalized Jerry Seinfeld and his friends in New York City.
The American version of The Office depicts employees at the Scranton branch of Dunder Mifflin.
The Big Bang Theory centers on a group of scientists and their friends in Pasadena.
Modern Family uses a mockumentary format to follow three connected families.
I Love Lucy stars Lucille Ball as Lucy Ricardo in a domestic sitcom.
Cheers centers on the staff and regular customers of a Boston bar.
Frasier follows psychiatrist and radio host Frasier Crane in Seattle.
The Golden Girls follows four older women sharing a home in Miami.
The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air follows a teenager from Philadelphia who moves in with relatives in Los Angeles.
Full House follows a father raising three daughters with help from his brother-in-law and best friend.
Parks and Recreation follows local government employees in the fictional town of Pawnee, Indiana.
Brooklyn Nine-Nine is a workplace sitcom set in a fictional New York City police precinct.
Abbott Elementary is a mockumentary sitcom about teachers at a Philadelphia public school.
How I Met Your Mother follows Ted Mosby and his friends through a story framed as his account to his children.
Community follows a study group at the fictional Greendale Community College.
30 Rock follows the staff of a fictional television sketch-comedy show.
NewsRadio is a workplace sitcom set at a fictional New York City radio station.
Better Off Ted is a workplace sitcom set at the fictional corporation Veridian Dynamics.
Party Down follows a Los Angeles catering crew whose members aspire to work in entertainment.
The Simpsons is an animated sitcom about a family living in Springfield.
It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia follows the dysfunctional group running Paddy's Pub.
The Good Place is a fantasy sitcom about people navigating the afterlife.
3rd Rock from the Sun follows aliens posing as a human family on Earth.
Herman's Head depicts its main character's thoughts through four personified aspects of his personality.
Get a Life stars Chris Elliott as an adult paperboy who lives with his parents.
New Girl follows teacher Jess Day and her roommates in Los Angeles.
Scrubs follows doctors and other staff at the fictional Sacred Heart Hospital.
Everybody Loves Raymond centers on sportswriter Ray Barone and his family.
Wings follows the people working around a small airline on Nantucket.
Happy Endings follows six friends living in Chicago.
Andy Richter Controls the Universe follows a technical writer whose imagination shapes the show's storytelling.

question.explanation: American sitcoms span decades, from early studio-audience classics to workplace mockumentaries and streaming comedies.
